description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

USAble Life is hiring a Web Developer I or II to develop, implement, maintain, and test software applications that support company systems. The role works with business analysts, developers, and project teams across the software development lifecycle and includes rotating on-call support, including nighttime support.
Web Developer building, testing, and maintaining business-system applications; documenting integration requirements and supporting QA and deployment

Responsibilities:
• Work with Business Analysts and Lead Developers to identify and document business requirements related to integration processes
• Analyze system specifications and develop, implement, maintain, and test software applications supporting company systems
• Recommend practical solutions to processing problems
• Support quality assurance and software deployment activities
• Participate in code reviews to provide feedback and strengthen understanding of software development practices
• Assist with application planning, design, development, and deployment
• Communicate work status proactively to development and project teams
• Review code to ensure compliance with standards, conventions, and application consistency
• Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned
• Participate in rotating on-call duties, including nighttime support

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Information Systems, with coursework or experience aligned with the required skills, or equivalent military experience
• For Web Developer I, at least one year of IT experience
• For Web Developer II, at least two years of IT experience, in addition to the Developer I requirements
• Experience with open-source tools such as log4net, NUnit, or NHibernate
• Experience using version control systems such as Git
• Experience writing SQL queries using database platforms such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, or Oracle
• Experience with software development or release-tracking tools such as JIRA or Targetprocess
• Strong understanding of programming concepts, object-oriented programming, secure coding concepts, and design patterns
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Attention to detail and strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to manage assigned tasks within established time constraints
• Understanding of testing tools, unit and integration test scripting, and testing methodologies

Preferred:
• Coursework focused on SQL and Microsoft .NET
• At least two years of IT experience
• IT-related experience in the health insurance industry
• Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines
• At least three years of IT experience
